prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1003; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to my first name for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Conroe, Texas, on a clear day. The light was green for me, I believe.
Q: Which direction were you traveling?
A: I was heading east, going straight through.
Q: What happened next?
A: A pickup came from my left and ran the red light. I tried to brake, but it hit the driver's side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Only for a split second. I saw it coming but there wasn't time to do anything.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: How fast were you going?
A: Maybe around the posted speed limit, I'd guess. I wasn't speeding.
Q: Did airbags deploy in your vehicle?
A: No, they didn't. The door caved in against my side, though.
Q: Did you get out of the car at the scene or wait for help?
A: I stayed in the car for a bit because my neck and lower back were hurting badly. Then the paramedics checked me out.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to a clinic the same day and I've been seeing a physical therapist since then.
Q: Can you describe your injuries?
A: I have a stiff, sore neck that makes it hard to turn my head, and my lower back aches, especially when I sit for long periods. The doctor said it's a neck and back strain.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injuries?
A: A few shifts so far. I'm still figuring out how much time I'll need.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm hoping this gets resolved fairly. Thank you.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
